description:
The Defense Logistics Agency - Energy (DLA Energy) will host an Into-Plane Information Session for current contract holders ONLY. Upcoming changes on the AIR Card ® Program will be discussed and contractors will have the opportunity to provide feedback to DLA Energy and voice thier concerns and questions about the new program. Contractors are invited to participate in indivdual information sessions with DLA AFTER March 18th, 2026. Please use the link below to sign up for individual sessions.

When: March 18th, 2026, starting at 9:00AM EST

Where: This will be a virtual event, credentials will be provided closer to the event. Registration is required

What: Topics to be discussed include: AIR Card® invoicing procedures, Fully Itemized Price Ticket

Who: Current Into-Plane Contract holders ONLY
